title: Baseline controls
description: Controls every baseline profile carries, whatever the jurisdiction. Each item validates against schemas/baseline-control.schema.json.

items.name: Agent controls
items.description: For each AI use at A3 and above: its permission scope, an action log, a human checkpoint before actions at A4 and above, and a way to stop it

items.name: Fast path
items.description: A position set by the board or accountable authority: AI uses at A1 and A2 with consequence C1 or C2 are approved by management within a stated number of days

items.name: One evidence register
items.description: Each provider's evidence (E0 to E6) recorded once and cross-walked to every regime in the matter brief

items.name: Productivity measures
items.description: Two measures in the board view, so an organization can show whether governance speeds or slows AI use
measures: Days from request to approval for a new AI use
Share of AI use on sanctioned tools
